name: aurora
description: Plataforma empresarial multiagente: Chief of Staff, especialistas, Cérebro e aprovação humana.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix apps/api ci && npm --prefix apps/web ci
scripts.setup:runtime: python -m venv apps/runtime/.venv && apps/runtime/.venv/Scripts/python -m pip install -r apps/runtime/requirements.txt
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/api run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
